response.sql: SELECT t.observstation AS station, o.lunarstage AS moon_phase, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage_pct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM telescopes m WHERE m.observstation = t.observstation AND m.equipstatus = 'Maintenance') GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY telescope_count DESC, t.observstation, o.lunarstage LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes with NULL equipstatus are not treated as 'Maintenance', so they do not disqualify a station. The maintenance check uses only telescopes that match an observatory, which is the same as all telescopes at a matched station.
The number of telescopes is COUNT(*) of telescope rows in each station and moon phase group. Ties in the count are broken by station and then moon phase, to make the top 10 deterministic.
